name: phantom_cascade
note: plan 后新增指向候选根 a3 的 CASCADE 子行，必须 STALE 而非未审阅删除

name: hold_after_plan
note: plan 后新增永久 hold 保护将被级联的 event 30

name: unrelated_index
note: 新增与闭包/谓词无关的目录元素（索引）不得使计划失效

name: unrelated_row_change
sql: UPDATE audit_log SET note='changed but irrelevant' WHERE id=1
note: NULL FK 的无关行修改不得使计划失效

name: in_lock_write_after_revalidation
note: 写锁持有期间 rival 写入应被 SQLITE_BUSY 挡住，计划照常提交

name: in_lock_write_before_commit
note: 提交前最后控制点 rival 仍被锁挡住，无检查后写入窗口

name: root_change_after_plan
sql: UPDATE account SET created_at=250 WHERE id=3
note: 根数据变化（cutoff 谓词相关列）必须 STALE
